cities.name: Baku
cities.local_food_tip: Enjoy traditional Azerbaijani dishes — kebab, plov (rice dish), dolma, fresh kebabs and local sweets — great mix of flavors by the sea.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🌅 Stroll along Baku Boulevard by the Caspian Sea, enjoy sea breeze and views. → 🏛️ Explore the Old City (Icherisheher) with ancient walls, mosques and narrow alleys. → ☕ Morning tea with baklava in a traditional teahouse.

Afternoon: 🏙️ Visit modern Flame Towers and Upland Park — panoramic views over city and sea. → 🍽️ Lunch: plov or kebab with fresh salad and Azerbaijani flatbread. → 🚶 Walk through modern streets, sea promenade and local markets.

Sunset: 🌇 Watch sunset from coastal promenade or rooftop terrace with sea view.

Night: 🌃 Dinner in a restaurant with local music, then stroll through illuminated city — blend of old & new.

ideas: 🌸 Blooming sea‑side parks and promenades, pleasant weather for walking.
🎨 Street art & cultural events around the city.
☕ Outdoor cafés with sea breeze — perfect for relaxing.
🌊 Evening walks by the Caspian and light sea breeze at night.
🍹 Waterfront dining — seafood, fresh salads and local wines.
🎶 Music and nightlife along modern streets and bars.
🍁 Walks through historic old town under golden light.
🥘 Hearty meals — stews and kebabs — as weather cools.
🏛️ Museums and cultural visits when days shorten.
🌫️ Misty sea‑side mornings — atmospheric walks along the boulevard.
🔥 Hot tea, traditional food and cozy indoor cafés.
📸 Evening lights over modern skyline and sea reflections.

public_transport_tips: 🚇 Use metro and buses to move around the city easily.
🚶 Many attractions are walkable — old town and promenade are pedestrian‑friendly.
🚕 Taxis or ride‑sharing useful for late‑night moves.
🎟️ Consider day‑pass for public transport if exploring many spots.

city_events.name: Baku Summer Sea & Music Fest
city_events.description: 🎶 Concerts, beach‑side gatherings and nightlife by the Caspian Sea.

city_events.name: Old City Heritage Week
city_events.description: 🏛️ Exhibits, cultural shows and historical tours in the Old Town.

cities.name: Sheki
cities.local_food_tip: Try local sweets (like shekerbura), walnut‑filled treats, traditional stews and fresh bread — rustic flavors with mountain vibes.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🏰 Walk through the walled old town, visit the Sheki Khan’s Palace with its ornate stained‑glass windows. → ☕ Traditional tea with local sweets in a courtyard house.

Afternoon: 🌳 Explore surrounding mountains or countryside villages — enjoy nature and local rural life. → 🍽️ Lunch with homemade dishes and fresh local produce.

Sunset: 🌇 Watch mountain golden hour over town rooftops. → 🚶 Evening stroll through narrow alleys, enjoy quiet local atmosphere.

ideas: 🌼 Blossoming hills and mild weather — ideal for exploring old town and nature nearby.
🎨 Local crafts‑workshops and artisan markets in town.
🍃 Fresh mountain air and calm surroundings.
🌄 Mountain hikes — escape the heat of lowland cities.
🌙 Evening relaxation in shaded courtyards or by river streams.
🥗 Light traditional meals with local herbs and vegetables.
🍁 Autumn colors in hills and village areas — amazing for photos.
🥘 Traditional hearty meals after harvest — walnuts, local produce, homemade dishes.
🏘️ Quiet old‑town strolls as tourist season slows down.
❄️ Snow in surrounding mountains — unlikely in town but nearby hills may have frost. Good for nature walks.
🔥 Cozy food and tea in historic houses and guesthouses.
🕯️ Peaceful, quiet evenings in a slow‑paced town atmosphere.

public_transport_tips: 🚍 Regional minibuses from major cities — main way to reach Sheki.
🚶 Town center walkable — best to explore on foot in old alleys.
🚗 For countryside or nearby hills — car helps, but check mountain road conditions.
🎒 Bring comfortable shoes for alleys and uneven terrain.

city_events.name: Sheki Crafts & Sweets Festival
city_events.description: 🍬 Local sweet tastings, crafts, traditional music and village‑style gatherings.

cities.name: Gabala
cities.local_food_tip: Mountain‑style dishes — fresh meat, soups, forest mushrooms, dairy products — hearty food after hikes or winter sports.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🏞️ Hike in the forests around Gabala, enjoy waterfalls and clear nature paths. → 🍽️ Lunch in a village tavern with local dishes.

Afternoon: 🎿 In winter — ski or snow activities; in other seasons — explore valleys, rivers or forested hills. → 🚣 Maybe river rafting or lake‑side rest depending on seasons.

Sunset: 🌅 Quiet nature sunset — ideal for photography or relaxation away from city noise.

Night: 🔥 Mountain lodge dinner, local hospitality and calm village night under stars.

ideas: 🌼 Forest paths bloom, rivers flow — ideal for hikes.
🥾 Gentle trekking and picnic days.
📸 Photography of waterfalls, mountains and fresh greenery.
🌲 Cool forest trails — break from summer heat.
🏕️ Camping or lakeside rest plus local food.
🌌 Starry nights far from light pollution.
🍁 Autumn foliage in forests and hills — scenic treks.
🥘 Hearty forest dishes and local produce meals.
🔥 Evening lodge dinners after day hikes.
🎿 Skiing, snowboarding or snow hikes in nearby slopes.
☕ Hot drinks and warm food in cozy lodges post‑ski.
❄️ Snowy landscapes and calm mountain ambience.

public_transport_tips: 🚍 Regional buses from main cities — common winter‑tourist route.
🚗 Renting a car helps for remote access to mountains and valleys.
🥾 Good hiking shoes are a must — terrain varies widely.
🎟️ Check seasonal passes if visiting ski areas or nature zones.

city_events.name: Gabala Mountain & Nature Week
city_events.description: 🥾 Guided hikes, nature excursions, forest tours and mountain‑village visits.

city_events.name: Winter Ski Opening Festival
city_events.description: ⛷️ Opening of ski season, snow activities, lodge dinners and local music.

cities.name: Shegar / Khinalig (High‑mountain village)
cities.local_food_tip: Local dairy products, handmade breads, simple stews — rustic and authentic mountain cuisine for hardy travellers.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🌄 Drive or hike to Khinalig — one of the oldest mountain villages in the Caucasus. → 🏞️ Walk through high‑altitude paths, enjoy panoramic views and pure mountain air.

Afternoon: 🐑 Visit local households, meet villagers, learn about traditional life, crafts and customs. → 🍲 Simple homemade lunch with village specialties.

Sunset: 🌇 Watch sunset over mountain ridges — atmosphere of remoteness and calm.

Night: 🕯️ Stay in a traditional guesthouse, enjoy local hospitality, simple dinner and clear starlit sky miles from city lights.

ideas: 🌼 Snowmelt and blooming wildflowers — fresh mountain scenery.
🦅 Birdwatching and rare alpine fauna spotting.
🚶 Easy walks in cool climate and crisp air.
🏕️ Camping or homestay in village — rustic, peaceful and authentic.
🌞 Day hikes, scenic panoramas and cool mountain breeze.
🛖 Village‑cultural exchange — learn about traditions and crafts.
🍂 Golden and red mountain colors — breathtaking views.
🔥 Traditional meals, village hospitality and quiet countryside nights.
📸 Photography of remote landscapes and cultural scenes.
❄️ Snowy village, silence and untouched mountain surroundings.
🔥 Cozy dinners, fire‑side talks and rustic guesthouse stays.
🌌 Fantastic stargazing under clear alpine sky.

public_transport_tips: 🚗 Car or off‑road vehicle recommended — remote access roads may be rough.
🎒 Bring warm clothes and supplies — isolation means fewer facilities.
🥾 Good hiking / mountain boots required — terrain is rugged.
📅 Best visited late spring to early autumn — winter may restrict access.

city_events.name: Highland Village Traditions Day
city_events.description: 🎶 Local music, traditions, village crafts and cultural exchange with mountain families.
